name: Elephan
subcategory: Revenue intelligence across conversations and CRM
tagline: Conversation intelligence, sales coaching and deal-risk insights

pricing.basis: Negotiated commercial terms; no public price verified
pricing.notes: Official terms say pricing and scope are agreed in a separate commercial proposal or contract.

verdictSummary: A weekend MVP can combine imported CRM deals and exported call or WhatsApp transcripts, use an LLM for sales scorecards and coaching, and rank deals with transparent rules. That is not the complete Elephan platform. Its value also depends on continuous multi-channel capture, maintained integrations, unified customer context and revenue predictions. Reliable forecasts need sufficient historical data and evaluation, not just an LLM prompt.
coreLoopDIY: Import deal records and conversation transcripts, identify risks and coaching opportunities, then surface evidence-backed next actions.
diyTimeEstimate: weekend MVP with imported files; production-grade intelligence takes much longer
requirements: OpenAI transcription and LLM API keys
Conversation transcripts collected with appropriate consent
whatYouLose: Automatic ingestion across WhatsApp, calls, meetings and multiple business tools
Continuously synchronized customer context and connectors
Historically validated prediction quality and monitoring
Enterprise permissions, security controls and production-grade support
moatNotes: The hard problem is clean cross-channel data and trustworthy risk interpretation, not a one-shot summary.
whyPeopleStillPay: A revenue leader buys a dependable picture of conversations and deal momentum across the team. File imports and scorecards are easy enough; keeping interactions complete, permissioned and correctly linked to deals at scale is the expensive work.

priorArt.name: n8n
priorArt.desc: Automation building block for importing and routing CRM events

notes: Public product evidence: https://www.elephan.ai/ ; pricing terms: https://www.elephan.ai/termos-e-condicoes-de-uso .
prompt:
Build a lightweight revenue intelligence dashboard using Next.js, TypeScript, SQLite, and the OpenAI API.
Make it a local single-team proof of concept, not an enterprise SaaS.
Allow CSV uploads of deals, contacts, stages and deal history.
Allow uploads of call transcripts and exported WhatsApp chat text.
Use OpenAI transcription only when an audio file is uploaded.
Associate each transcript with a deal via a user-selected deal ID.
Extract objections, buying signals, risks and promised next steps.
Generate evidence-linked scorecards for sales discovery quality.
Display a deal timeline combining stage changes and conversations.
Compute transparent risk signals from inactivity and stage age.
Label these as heuristic rules, not trained conversion probabilities.
Create a sortable deal-risk queue with evidence for each flag.
Show a simple funnel by stage and manually entered expected revenue.
Summarize trends in objections and sales coaching opportunities.
Add a conversational question box querying only imported records.
Return originating transcript excerpts with each AI answer.
Make imports idempotent and provide a duplicate review screen.
Keep conversations in SQLite and allow export or deletion.
Provide sample CSV and transcript fixtures plus smoke tests.
Do not implement automatic WhatsApp capture or VoIP integrations.
Do not claim validated forecasts or enterprise compliance.
Load API keys from .env and document consent, privacy and limitations.
